From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Concordia MAP and sprint charter: phased vs fast-track options

Hi Jordan / Priyanka,

Thanks again for the time earlier — attaching our first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Concordia_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW draft. I sketched two reasonable implementation paths based on the scope we discussed (ingestion, model routing, and private VPC option). Please review and tell me which path you'd prefer so we can lock dates and owners.

Summary (high level)
- Fast Track (6 weeks): compressed onboarding for teams that can commit full-time resources. Single sprint, parallel workstreams (data, infra, integration). Recommended only if Concordia can provide sample data and security docs within 5 business days.
- Phased (12 weeks): staggered sprints — Phase 1 (data ingestion + basic routing), Phase 2 (quality tuning + caching/batching), Phase 3 (go-live + adoption + rollback play). Lower risk for teams with limited bandwidth.

Draft milestone grid (extract from spreadsheet):
- Kickoff: week of Apr 17 (TBD)
- Data model mapping complete: +2 weeks after kickoff
- Ingestion & transformation POC: +4 weeks
- Integration tests and load run: +8 weeks
- Go-live window (can be staged): week 10-12

Decisions we need from you:
1) Track choice: Fast Track (6w) or Phased (12w)?
2) Primary product/infra contacts (name + email) for implementation and security questionnaire
3) Any blackout dates or internal approval gates we should plan around

Attachments: Concordia_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestone grid), SOW-Concordia-draft.pdf (scope + T&Cs).
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeF-Concordia-MAP

If the phased plan looks better, I will loop in our SE and CS ops to propose firm owners and dates. Looking for a quick confirmation by EOD Wed.

Thanks,
--

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear options. After a quick sync here, Concordia prefers the Phased (12-week) approach to reduce operational risk while our security team finishes the vendor review. A few clarifying items before we lock dates:

1) SOC 2 / audit artifacts: we will need SOC 2 Type II evidence plus the network segmentation diagram before final approval. Can those be added to the security packet?
2) Data ingestion: we prefer to start schema mapping ahead of kickoff if possible. We can share sample payloads next Friday (Apr 14). Will that be sufficient?
3) Private VPC: is the VPC provisioning (if we choose private) happening before Phase 2 or is it possible to do a hybrid (hosted first, private later)?

Attendees we plan to send to kickoff: me (Jordan Li), Priyanka Shah (PM), and our Dev lead (TBD — I will confirm name by next Tue).

Also looping in Priyanka on scheduling.

-Jordan

Thanks — I reviewed the draft and sketched a pragmatic milestone plan (SE view). I also added dependencies and risk flags. See below.

SE-proposed milestone schedule (Phased, baseline):
- Kickoff (internal + Concordia): Mon Apr 17, 2028 10:00 PDT
- Week 1-2 (Data & Schema): data sample intake, schema mapping, and ETL POC — owner: Karthik / Concordia Dev Lead — target complete Apr 30
- Week 3-5 (Ingestion + routing): build connectors, baseline routing rules, KV cache POC — owner: SEs / Ben — target complete May 21
- Week 6-8 (Quality tuning): model tuning, prompt sets, latency tuning, batching configs — owner: CS + SEs (Monica / Karthik) — target complete Jun 11
- Week 9-12 (Staging & go-live): integration tests, load run, staging cutover, go-live window — owner: Monica / Ops — go-live target Jun 25 - Jul 2 window

Top dependencies & risk items:
1) SOC2 artifacts + network diagram (security approval) — Concordia must provide sign-off; procurement gate before final Phase 1 sign-off
2) Private VPC provisioning (if requested) — estimated 2 weeks once PO and network details provided; can be slotted into Week 6-7 to avoid blocking initial testing (hybrid approach supported)
3) Quantization & model variant pinning — requires representative payloads for A/B quality checks; recommend sample set >= 10k tokens across request types
4) Sizing for load tests — need target QPS and peak window; suggest a dedicated load run in Week 10

Other operational notes:
- I'll prepare a short playbook for rollback and fallbacks (model variant fallback) and a test checklist for the staging run.
- Ops: Ben, can you confirm standby window for an infra smoke run the week of Apr 24?

Attachments: Implementation-Notes.txt (SE checklist + test cases)
